description: This file defines a custom view component 'SlidingTabStrip' for an Android application. It manages the visual representation of tab indicators, including the bottom border, selected indicator, and dividers. The class handles drawing these elements, updating appearance based on user interaction, and supports custom coloring.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that displays tab indicators and decorative lines for a tabbed layout.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface for providing indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: A private static nested class implementing TabColorizer, providing color arrays for tab indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the selected tab indicator, replacing the default.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets divider colors for the tabs, replacing the default.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset when the page changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the tab indicator, bottom border, and dividers.
